orchestrator.description: Lead Penetration Testing Orchestrator for an AI-driven security browser built on Electron and Playwright. Coordinates autonomous security assessments: reconnaissance/mapping, hypothesis generation, execution via tool scripts, delegation to @evaluator, and reporting.

evaluator.description: Evidence Analysis and False-Positive Filtering subagent. Reviews execution logs, console output, DOM changes, and network responses from @orchestrator; validates hypotheses with strict evidence-based reasoning; responds only with the structured JSON evaluation format (vulnerable, confidence, reason). Does not execute actions, modify code, or run terminal commands.

dom-analyzer.description: Fast DOM Analyzer subagent. Inspects raw HTML snapshots, DOM trees, or accessibility trees; extracts elements, forms, inputs, attributes, and event handlers for @orchestrator; acts as a cheap filter to condense DOM noise into concise findings. Does not execute actions, modify code, or run terminal commands.
